title_zh: 苹果一大波智能家居新品曝光，最快下周发布
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果正与 LG 共同开发一系列智能家居配件，包括有线视频门铃、智能门锁、恒温器、温度传感器，以及室内、室外和泛光灯摄像头。

这批产品将使用 LG 品牌，制造和售后由 LG 负责，并与苹果即将推出的家庭中枢、新 HomePod mini 和 Apple TV 配合使用。

部分设备已出现在监管资料中，多款配件支持 Wi-Fi、蓝牙、Thread 和 Matter，门锁还支持 UWB，可实现靠近自动解锁。这批配件还要再等几个月才能买到。

触屏 MacBook 方面，macOS 27.2 测试版中，长按 Dock 里的应用图标会出现轻微放大的反馈，类似 iPhone 和 iPad 上的长按效果。

目前消息指向 14 英寸和 16 英寸两款机型，可能沿用 MacBook Pro 之名，也可能采用传闻中的 MacBook Ultra，预计 10 月或 11 月推出，将配备触控屏、双层 OLED、更薄的机身和灵动岛，芯片仍为 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max。Mark Gurman 称，新机会「明显更轻」。

iPad mini 8 预计 10 月发布，有望采用 OLED 面板和更窄的边框，搭载 A20 Pro 芯片，内存从 8 GB 增至 12 GB，前置摄像头位置也将调整。

🔗 相关阅读：苹果一大波新品要来了，阵仗不输 iPhone 发布会
title_en: Apple's Upcoming Smart Home Lineup and Next-Gen Hardware Leaked
content_en:
Apple is reportedly collaborating with LG to develop a new range of smart home accessories, including wired video doorbells, smart locks, thermostats, temperature sensors, and indoor/outdoor security cameras. These LG-branded devices will integrate with Apple's upcoming home hub, a new HomePod mini, and Apple TV.

Regulatory filings reveal support for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Thread, and Matter, with the smart lock featuring Ultra-Wideband (UWB) technology for automatic unlocking.

Beyond smart home gear, details on future Macs and iPads have emerged. The macOS 27.2 beta hints at touchscreen MacBooks, featuring iOS-like long-press feedback on Dock icons. Rumored 14-inch and 16-inch models—potentially named MacBook Ultra—are expected in October or November. These laptops will reportedly feature tandem OLED touchscreens, a thinner and "significantly lighter" chassis, Dynamic Island, and M5 Pro/Max chips.

Additionally, the iPad mini 8 is anticipated to debut in October. Upgrades include an OLED display, slimmer bezels, an A20 Pro chip, RAM boosted to 12GB, and a repositioned front-facing camera.

title_zh: OpenAI 向 Chat 用户推送 GPT-6，并加入可交互界面
content_zh:
OpenAI 10 月 7 日宣布，GPT-6 开始向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户推送，Free 与 Go 用户将在今天起陆续获得更新。

GPT-6 在 ChatGPT 中加入「Intelligent UI」，回答可以组合图形、按钮、表单、图表和可交互体验，也能直接生成计算器、分账工具等小型应用。

OpenAI 表示，GPT-6 能在继续思考时逐步开始回答；在内部评测中，GPT-6 Instant 平均比 GPT-5.6 Instant 提前 44% 开始回答需要联网搜索的问题。ChatGPT 版本由 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 驱动，Work 与 Codex 使用的模型暂不变化。
title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 with Interactive 'Intelligent UI'
content_en:
OpenAI has officially begun rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, with Free and Go users set to receive the update progressively.

The headline feature of this release is the "Intelligent UI," which allows ChatGPT to generate interactive elements such as graphics, buttons, forms, charts, and even functional mini-applications like calculators and bill splitters directly within the chat interface.

Performance-wise, GPT-6 introduces progressive answering, allowing the model to start responding while it continues to process and think. Internal benchmarks show that GPT-6 Instant initiates answers to web-search queries 44% faster than GPT-5.6 Instant. The updated ChatGPT experience is powered by the GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna models, while Work and Codex models remain unchanged for now.

title_zh: 曝 DeepSeek 即将完成至少 800 亿元融资
content_zh:
据彭博社 10 月 6 日援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 即将完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币的融资，腾讯和宁德时代是其中最大的投资方之一。路透社随后转述了这项消息。

这轮融资最初计划筹集约 500 亿元人民币；按目前签署的投资条款计算，最终规模可能接近 1000 亿元人民币。智东西援引彭博社称，这轮融资可能为 2027 年初的 IPO 铺路，但交易条款和上市安排都还没有最终确定。三组数字分别对应当前预计规模、最初目标与潜在最终规模，融资尚未正式宣布完成。

路透社称，DeepSeek、腾讯和宁德时代均未立即回应置评请求。DeepSeek 此前已与华为合作开发适配昇腾芯片的编程工具，并在 9 月推出 V4.1 Flash 模型。
title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Nearing Massive 80 Billion Yuan Funding Round
content_en:
Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is reportedly close to finalizing a massive funding round of at least 80 billion RMB (approximately $11.3 billion USD), with tech giant Tencent and battery maker CATL among the lead investors, according to Bloomberg.

While the funding round initially targeted 50 billion RMB, strong investor interest could push the final figure close to 100 billion RMB. Sources suggest this capital injection could pave the way for an initial public offering (IPO) as early as 2027, though the exact terms and listing schedules remain tentative.

DeepSeek, Tencent, and CATL have not officially commented on the reports. DeepSeek has been rapidly expanding its footprint, having recently partnered with Huawei to optimize programming tools for Ascend chips and launching its V4.1 Flash model in September.

title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，API 价格最高降低 90%
content_zh:
Anthropic 10 月 7 日发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，定位是面向高并发、成本敏感任务的小模型，适用于摘要、压缩、数据库查询、分类、客服和浏览器操作。官方称，Haiku 5.5 的运行成本平均比 Haiku 4.5 低约 75%，处理 10 万 tokens 以内请求时价格低 90%。

按每百万 tokens 计，Haiku 5.5 的输入价格为 0.10 美元，输出价格为 0.50 美元；缓存读取和写入分别为 0.01 美元和 0.125 美元。模型还首次提供可调节 effort 设置，并已在 Claude Platform、Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 上线。

Anthropic 同时把 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格从每百万 tokens 0.20 美元降至 0.10 美元，称多数 Agent 任务成本可下降约 20%。Claude Max 5x、Max 20x 和 Team 用户本周还将分别获得每月 100 美元、200 美元和最高 500 美元的 API 额度。
title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Haiku 5.5 with Up to 90% Lower API Costs
content_en:
Anthropic has officially released Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight model designed for high-concurrency and cost-sensitive tasks such as summarization, database queries, customer service, and browser automation. According to the company, Haiku 5.5 reduces average running costs by 75% compared to Haiku 4.5, with savings reaching up to 90% for requests under 100,000 tokens.

Pricing for Haiku 5.5 is set at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with prompt caching reads and writes priced at $0.01 and $0.125, respectively. The model also introduces an adjustable "effort" setting and is now available across the Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

In addition, Anthropic has halved the cache read pricing for Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens, which is expected to cut agent-related task costs by about 20%. The company is also distributing monthly API credits of $100, $200, and up to $500 to Claude Max 5x, Max 20x, and Team users this week.

title_zh: 月之暗面估值据报升至约 500 亿美元，筹备明年赴港上市
content_zh:
彭博社 10 月 6 日援引知情人士称，Kimi 开发商月之暗面已完成上市前最后一轮私募融资，估值达到约 500 亿美元。

公司正争取在 2027 年第一季度于香港上市，并计划最早在本月与潜在投资者举行初步会面，了解市场对上市的兴趣。
title_en: Kimi Developer Moonshot AI Reportedly Valued at $50 Billion Ahead of Hong Kong IPO
content_en:
Moonshot AI, the developer behind the popular AI assistant Kimi, has reportedly completed its final pre-IPO private funding round, boosting its valuation to approximately $50 billion, according to Bloomberg sources.

The Chinese AI startup is aiming for an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong by the first quarter of 2027. To gauge market interest, the company plans to hold preliminary meetings with potential investors as early as this month.

title_zh: Nano Banana 2.1 上线，改进文字生成与多图编辑
content_zh:
Google 的图像生成与对话式编辑模型 Nano Banana 2.1 已提供稳定版 API，模型标识为 gemini-nano-banana-2.1。它是 Nano Banana 2 的更新版本，改进了视觉质量、提示词遵循和连续多轮编辑中的人物一致性。

新版支持 1K、2K 和 4K 图像输出，默认分辨率为 1K。Google 表示，它改进了文字渲染和信息图布局，并修复了 2K、4K 超宽或全景图中的拼接瑕疵。

编辑任务最多可参考 14 张图片，其中支持保持最多 4 个角色和 10 个物体的一致性。开发者还可结合 Google 网页与图片搜索生成图像，并选择最小、中等或高强度的思考设置。
title_en: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1 with Enhanced Text Rendering and Multi-Image Editing
content_en:
Google has released the stable API for Nano Banana 2.1 (`gemini-nano-banana-2.1`), its latest image generation and conversational editing model. As an upgrade to Nano Banana 2, the new version delivers significant improvements in visual quality, prompt adherence, and character consistency across multi-turn edits.

The model supports 1K, 2K, and 4K image outputs, with 1K as the default resolution. Google has enhanced text rendering and infographic layouts while fixing stitching artifacts in ultra-wide and panoramic 2K and 4K images.

For advanced editing, Nano Banana 2.1 can reference up to 14 images simultaneously, maintaining consistency for up to four characters and ten objects. Additionally, developers can leverage Google Web and Image Search to guide image generation and select from low, medium, or high "thinking" intensity settings.

title_zh: 2026 年诺贝尔奖陆续公布，目前已有 6 位得主
content_zh:
截至昨日，2026 年诺贝尔奖已公布生理学或医学奖、物理学奖和化学奖，共有 6 位科学家获奖；文学奖、和平奖和经济学奖将在接下来几天陆续公布。

今年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖授予 Karl Deisseroth、Peter Hegemann 和 Georg Nagel，以表彰他们「在光门控离子通道和光遗传学方面的发现」。三人的研究推动了光遗传学的发展，使研究人员能够利用光精确控制特定神经细胞活动，并借此研究记忆、情绪和行为背后的神经回路。

诺贝尔物理学奖由 Francis Halzen 一人获得，获奖理由为「对冰立方中微子天文台作出的决定性贡献，以及发现具有天体物理起源的高能中微子」。Halzen 推动利用南极冰层探测中微子，最终建成体积约 1 立方千米、布置有 5160 个光学传感器的 IceCube 中微子天文台，为高能中微子天文学开辟了新的观测窗口。

昨日公布的诺贝尔化学奖授予 Henri B. Kagan 和 Kenso Soai，以表彰二人「发现不对称有机合成中的非线性效应和自催化现象」。

相关研究解释了化学反应如何产生并不断放大特定的分子「手性」，有助于理解生命中同手性现象的形成，并对药物合成中的不对称反应设计产生重要影响。两人将平分 1200 万瑞典克朗奖金。

按照诺贝尔奖官方日程，文学奖将于今日公布，和平奖和经济学奖分别将在 10 月 9 日和 10 月 12 日公布。

🔗 相关阅读：2026 诺贝尔物理学奖揭晓，他用南极冰层观测宇宙
title_en: First Six 2026 Nobel Prize Winners Announced
content_en:
The first wave of the 2026 Nobel Prizes has been unveiled, with six scientists honored across the fields of Physiology or Medicine, Physics, and Chemistry. The remaining prizes for Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences are scheduled for announcement over the coming days.

The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for their pioneering discoveries in light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. Their work has revolutionized neuroscience, enabling researchers to use light to precisely control specific neural activities and study the underlying circuits of memory, emotion, and behavior.

Francis Halzen was named the sole recipient of the Nobel Prize in Physics for his decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy cosmic neutrinos. Halzen championed the use of Antarctic ice to detect these elusive particles, leading to the construction of the IceCube observatory, which features 5,160 optical sensors embedded in a cubic kilometer of ice.

The Nobel Prize in Chemistry went to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for discovering non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. Their research explains how chemical reactions amplify molecular chirality, shedding light on the origins of homochirality in living organisms and significantly impacting drug design. The duo will share the 12 million Swedish kronor prize.

According to the official schedule, the Literature prize will be announced today, followed by the Peace Prize on October 9 and the Economic Sciences prize on October 12.

title_zh: 华为徐直军：昇腾在中国可统计市场的份额已超过英伟达
content_zh:
在近日公布的华为全联接大会媒体交流纪要中，轮值董事长徐直军表示，中国市场的英伟达份额很难统计，但按华为能够统计到的数据看，昇腾的市场份额应该已经超过英伟达。

徐直军称，当前昇腾供给仍不足以满足中国市场需求，华为没有全面拓展海外市场的计划，国内客户将获得优先供应；海外业务主要面向少数确有需求、难以取得算力或需要另一种选择的客户。

基于 950DT 的超节点仍处于测试阶段，预计今年年底或明年初开始规模供货。他预计，从明年起会有大量模型训练建立在这一系统上。

谈到芯片供应瓶颈，徐直军认为，光模块、存储等环节都没有为 AI 需求的快速增长做好准备，全球供需平衡可能到 2029 年才能实现，中国可能更晚。华为单芯片仍受国内工艺限制，多芯片互联和系统架构则是其重点投入的路线。

华为 10 月 5 日公布的另一场媒体圆桌中，余承东表示，鸿蒙 6、鸿蒙 7 的设备总数已超过 9000 万台，预计年底超过 1 亿台；华为已有将鸿蒙推向海外的初步计划，将分步骤推进。

余承东称，自 2019 年以来，华为持续重构供应链，并在 2023 年恢复手机芯片的国内制造。按照他的说法，华为在芯片和操作系统层面已基本摆脱对美国技术的依赖，国产先进制程的产能仍然紧张。
title_en: Huawei's Eric Xu Claims Ascend AI Chips Have Surpassed Nvidia in Trackable Chinese Market
content_en:
Huawei's Rotating Chairman, Eric Xu, stated during a recent media briefing that the company's Ascend AI chips have likely overtaken Nvidia in market share within China's trackable market segments. However, Xu noted that Nvidia's exact market share in China remains difficult to calculate.

Despite the growth, Ascend's supply still falls short of domestic demand. Consequently, Huawei has no immediate plans for a full-scale global expansion, prioritizing domestic customers instead. International sales will be restricted to select clients with critical computing needs. Xu also revealed that Huawei's 950DT-based supernodes are currently in testing, with volume shipments expected by late this year or early next year, paving the way for large-scale model training.

Addressing supply chain bottlenecks, Xu warned that global AI supply and demand might not balance out until 2029, with China potentially facing an even longer recovery. Due to domestic manufacturing constraints on single-chip performance, Huawei is heavily investing in multi-chip interconnects and advanced system architectures.

In a separate briefing, Richard Yu, head of Huawei's consumer business, shared updates on the company's software ecosystem. Devices running HarmonyOS 6 and 7 have surpassed 90 million and are projected to top 100 million by the end of the year. Huawei is also planning a phased global rollout for HarmonyOS. Yu emphasized that Huawei has largely eliminated its reliance on U.S. technology for chips and operating systems, though domestic advanced manufacturing capacity remains tight.

title_zh: 高通澄清华为专利协议：不涉及逻辑折叠，也非净支付方
content_zh:
10 月 6 日，高通向第一财经回应称，外界关于其在华为专利许可协议中属于「净支付方」的消息不准确，协议涉及逻辑折叠芯片技术的说法也不属实。高通同时确认，已同意购买华为在多个技术领域的部分非蜂窝通信美国专利。

双方于 10 月 5 日公布的是一项多年期专利许可协议，涵盖 5G、计算、AI 和网络等领域的专利组合交叉许可，并包含部分美国专利的转让。高通的最新回应区分了协议已公开的授权范围与市场流传的具体技术、支付方向，协议商业条款仍属保密内容。

第一财经称，相关交易还需获得必要的监管批准。高通技术许可业务负责人 John Han 表示，协议体现了双方对彼此在 5G 及其他领域知识产权的认可；华为首席知识产权官樊志勇则表示，协议展示了华为创新的价值。
title_en: Qualcomm Clarifies Huawei Patent Deal, Denies Being "Net Payer" or Licensing "Logic Folding" Tech
content_en:
Qualcomm has dismissed rumors surrounding its recent patent licensing agreement with Huawei, clarifying that it is not a "net payer" in the deal. The U.S. chipmaker also denied claims that the agreement involves "logic folding" chip technology. However, Qualcomm did confirm it has agreed to acquire certain non-cellular U.S. patents from Huawei across various technology sectors.

Announced on October 5, the multi-year agreement includes a cross-licensing arrangement of patent portfolios covering 5G, computing, AI, and network technologies, alongside the transfer of select U.S. patents. The specific financial and commercial terms of the deal remain confidential, and the transaction is still subject to regulatory approvals.

John Han, head of Qualcomm Technology Licensing, stated that the agreement reflects mutual respect for each other's intellectual property in 5G and other fields. Alan Fan, Huawei's Chief Intellectual Property Officer, echoed this sentiment, noting that the deal highlights the value of Huawei's technological innovations.

title_zh: 蔚来单日换电达 18.37 万单，再创纪录
content_zh:
据 IT 之家报道，蔚来 10 月 6 日公布，10 月 5 日单日换电量达到 183,664 单，超过 10 月 1 日创下的 183,469 单纪录。这一总量覆盖蔚来、乐道与萤火虫三个品牌，按全天统计，平均约每 0.47 秒完成一单换电。

返程期间，高速站的单站换电量也上升。山东日照沈海高速日照服务区海口方向站完成 188 单，广东江门大槐服务区沈阳方向站完成 176 单；江苏江都与洪泽湖的两座高速站以 171 单并列第三。

截至此次公布，蔚来在全国已建成 4,165 座换电站，累计提供超过 1.27 亿次换电服务。其中，高速公路换电站为 1,073 座，形成「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」网络，连通超过 550 个城市。
title_en: Nio Hits Record 183,664 Battery Swaps in a Single Day
content_en:
Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer Nio set a new daily record on October 5, completing 183,664 battery swaps across its network. This milestone, which averages out to one swap every 0.47 seconds, surpasses the previous record of 183,469 set just days earlier on October 1. The figures cover Nio's main brand as well as its Onvo and Firefly sub-brands.

The surge in demand was particularly evident at highway service stations during the holiday travel rush. Top-performing stations in Shandong, Guangdong, and Jiangsu provinces recorded up to 188 swaps in a single day.

To date, Nio has established 4,165 battery swap stations across China, collectively facilitating over 127 million swaps. This network includes 1,073 highway stations, connecting more than 550 cities through a comprehensive national grid.

title_zh: 全球纯汽油车份额首次跌破 50%
content_zh:
据日经亚洲 10 月初披露的 Mobility Global 数据，今年上半年，纯汽油车占全球新车销量的比例降至 49%，首次跌破一半。相关车型销量为 2025 万辆，同比下降 10%；市场份额比去年同期下降 3 个百分点，2021 年这一比例仍为 73%。

这项统计不包含混合动力及其他电气化车型，也排除了部分重型车辆。纯电动车上半年售出 687 万辆，同比增长 12%，占全球新车销量的 17%；混动车售出 727 万辆，同比增长 10%，占比 18%。

日经将变化与中东冲突后油价走高、消费者寻找更低使用成本的车型联系起来。纯汽油车销量在中国下降 26%，欧洲下降 13%。纯电动车的增长主要来自欧洲、东南亚和大洋洲，其中欧洲销量增长 32%，东南亚增长 81%。

中国仍贡献约一半的全球纯电动车销量，但今年上半年销量同比下降 3%；北美下降 15%，两地均受到激励政策调整影响。
title_en: Pure Gasoline Cars Fall Below 50% of Global Sales for the First Time
content_en:
For the first time in history, pure gasoline vehicles accounted for less than half of global new car sales, dropping to a 49% market share in the first half of this year, according to data from Mobility Global. Sales of gasoline-only cars fell 10% year-on-year to 20.25 million units, a sharp decline from 2021 when they held a dominant 73% of the market.

In contrast, electrified vehicles continued to gain ground. Electric vehicles (EVs) saw a 12% year-on-year increase, reaching 6.87 million units and capturing 17% of the market. Hybrid vehicles grew by 10% to 7.27 million units, representing an 18% share. Analysts attribute the shift to rising fuel costs and consumers seeking more economical transportation options.

Geographically, gasoline car sales plunged 26% in China and 13% in Europe. Meanwhile, EV growth was strongest in Southeast Asia (up 81%) and Europe (up 32%). Although China still accounts for nearly half of global EV sales, its domestic EV sales dipped 3% in the first half of the year, while North America saw a 15% decline, largely due to adjustments in government subsidy policies.

title_zh: 韩国计划投入 4.7 万亿韩元开发前沿 AI 模型
content_zh:
据路透社报道，韩国科学技术信息通信部 10 月 6 日宣布，计划从 2027 年 3 月启动前沿 AI 模型项目，总投入为 4.7 万亿韩元，约合 35 亿美元。

项目将结合政府股权投资与民间资金，集中芯片、数据和人才资源。企业可单独参与，也可与初创公司、大学和研究机构组建联合体或特殊目的公司竞标。

这项计划仍需国会在 12 月批准明年的预算。预算通过后，政府将启动牵头机构招标，最快于明年 2 月选定团队。另一个正在进行的本土基础模型项目会继续推进，预计于明年 2 月进入第三阶段，选出最终两支团队。
title_en: South Korea to Invest $3.5 Billion in Frontier AI Models
content_en:
South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT has announced a major initiative to develop frontier AI models, planning a total investment of 4.7 trillion won (approximately $3.5 billion) starting in March 2027.

The project will leverage a combination of government equity and private funding to pool critical resources, including advanced semiconductors, data, and top-tier talent. Participating companies can bid individually or form consortia and special purpose vehicles with startups, universities, and research institutions.

The initiative is subject to parliamentary budget approval this December. Once approved, the government will launch a bidding process to select leading development teams as early as February next year. This project runs alongside an existing domestic foundation model program, which is scheduled to enter its third phase in February to select two final teams.

title_zh: Google 签下约 3.6 吉瓦电力协议，核电增容占约四分之一
content_zh:
Google 与美国能源公司 Constellation Energy 宣布达成长期电力协议，采购规模合计 3590 兆瓦，约合 3.6 吉瓦。新增核电约占其中四分之一，电力将接入美国最大的电网 PJM。

其中，Google 签订了一份为期 20 年、规模为 890 兆瓦的核电采购协议。Constellation 将升级现有反应堆以增加发电量，涉及伊利诺伊州、宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州的 11 台核电机组，首批增容电力预计于 2028 年交付。

另外 2700 兆瓦来自 Constellation 的长期供电安排，不绑定特定发电方式。两家公司表示，此次合作将带动 Constellation 超过 43 亿美元的新投资。

PJM 此前提出，接入电网的数据中心应自带电源，否则在用电高峰时可能被远程断供。两家公司称，本次协议正是对这一提议的回应。
title_en: Google Secures 3.6 GW Power Deal with Constellation, Boosting Nuclear Capacity
content_en:
Google has partnered with US energy giant Constellation Energy in a massive long-term power agreement totaling 3,590 megawatts (approximately 3.6 GW). The deal, which will feed into the PJM Interconnection—the largest electrical grid in the US—includes a significant nuclear component making up about a quarter of the total capacity.

Under a 20-year, 890 MW nuclear power purchase agreement, Constellation will upgrade 11 existing nuclear units across Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey to boost generation. The first phase of this expanded nuclear capacity is slated for delivery in 2028. The remaining 2,700 MW will come from Constellation's broader long-term supply arrangements.

The collaboration is expected to catalyze over $4.3 billion in new investments by Constellation. According to both companies, the agreement directly addresses a recent proposal by PJM requiring data centers to secure their own power sources to avoid potential remote disconnections during peak demand periods.

title_zh: Suno 在意大利被调查，单方改价和版权条款受质疑
content_zh:
意大利竞争监管机构 AGCM 于 10 月 6 日宣布，对 AI 音乐生成公司 Suno 启动调查，审查其服务条款是否对消费者不公平。监管机构认为，相关条款可能造成用户权利与义务的显著失衡。

调查涉及 Suno 单方面修改合同、服务和订阅价格的权力：公司可在无需说明正当理由的情况下作出调整。另一项焦点是用户授予平台的版权许可，监管机构认为其范围过于宽泛，要求用户放弃著作人格权的安排也可能违反意大利版权法。

Suno 的条款还要求用户在美国接受强制仲裁、放弃集体诉讼，并将马萨诸塞州设为专属管辖地，这些安排同样进入审查范围。

AGCM 将在未来数周展开公开咨询，允许行业组织、商会和消费者协会参与。调查尚未形成最终裁决；据路透社报道，Suno 暂未回应置评请求。
title_en: AI Music Generator Suno Under Investigation in Italy Over Unfair Terms and Copyright Clauses
content_en:
Italy’s competition authority, AGCM, has launched an investigation into AI music generation platform Suno over concerns that its terms of service are unfair to consumers. The regulator suspects that the company's terms create a significant imbalance in rights and obligations between the platform and its users.

The probe focuses on Suno's right to unilaterally modify contracts, services, and subscription pricing without providing justification. Additionally, the AGCM is scrutinizing the broad copyright licenses users must grant to the platform, including clauses requiring users to waive their moral rights, which may violate Italian copyright law.

Other terms under review include clauses forcing users into mandatory arbitration in the US, waiving class-action rights, and designating Massachusetts as the exclusive legal jurisdiction. The AGCM plans to launch a public consultation in the coming weeks to gather input from industry groups and consumer associations. Suno has not yet responded to requests for comment.

title_zh: OpenAI 公开 722 篇数学手稿，部分证明仍待核验
content_zh:
OpenAI 公开了由内部前沿模型生成的 722 篇数学手稿，并将成果整理进 GitHub 仓库。它们按 372 个成果家族归类，一组可能包含主结果、相关推论或不同证明方式，不能简单理解为解出了 722 道独立难题。

这些手稿处于不同核验阶段：部分配有 Lean 形式化证明，部分仍依赖非形式化论证。OpenAI 提醒，尚未形式化的内容可能存在错误，将继续检查并修订。

WIRED 此前报道，公布计划引发部分数学家的质疑，争议涉及评审、引用和发表流程。OpenAI 表示，在与普林斯顿高等研究院一个独立研究团队沟通后，调整了公开方式、引用规范及后续讨论安排。生成这些研究的模型尚未发布。
title_en: OpenAI Releases 722 AI-Generated Math Manuscripts, Sparking Academic Debate
content_en:
OpenAI has publicly released 722 mathematical manuscripts generated by its unreleased frontier models, publishing the findings in a GitHub repository. The documents are categorized into 372 "result families"—meaning they represent clusters of main results, corollaries, or alternative proofs rather than 722 entirely independent solved problems.

The manuscripts are currently in various stages of verification. While some are accompanied by formal proofs in the Lean theorem prover, others rely on informal reasoning. OpenAI has cautioned that the unformalized proofs may still contain errors and will undergo ongoing review and revision.

The release has sparked debate within the mathematical community regarding peer review, citation, and publication standards. In response to feedback and discussions with an independent research team at the Institute for Advanced Study (IAS) in Princeton, OpenAI adjusted its publication approach, citation guidelines, and plans for future discussions.

title_zh: 曝可灵 AI 选定上市银行，香港 IPO 拟募资至少 10 亿美元
content_zh:
据彭博社援引知情人士报道，快手旗下的视频生成业务可灵 AI 已选定中金公司、高盛和瑞银，筹备在香港上市，计划募资至少 10 亿美元。

上市最早可能在明年进行。知情人士称，讨论仍在推进，募资规模和时间都可能调整；高盛和瑞银拒绝置评，可灵 AI 与中金公司未回应置评请求。

可灵 AI 于 2024 年推出，提供通过文字或图片生成视频的工具。此次筹备的是这一 AI 视频业务的上市，报道尚未给出已经确定的发行时间表。
title_en: Kuaishou's Kling AI Eyes $1 Billion Hong Kong IPO, Selects Underwriters
content_en:
Kling AI, the video-generation arm of Chinese short-video giant Kuaishou, has selected China International Capital Corp (CICC), Goldman Sachs, and UBS to prepare for an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong, according to Bloomberg. The company aims to raise at least $1 billion.

The listing could take place as early as next year. However, sources noted that discussions are still in the early stages, and the size and timing of the offering remain subject to change. Goldman Sachs and UBS declined to comment, while Kling AI and CICC did not respond to requests for comment.

Launched in 2024, Kling AI provides advanced tools that generate high-quality videos from text or image prompts. This planned IPO specifically targets the AI video business, though a definitive timeline has not yet been established.

title_zh: SpaceX 据报洽谈 400 亿美元融资，用于采购英伟达芯片
content_zh:
彭博社 10 月 7 日援引知情人士报道，SpaceX 正与银行及投资机构进行早期磋商，计划筹集 400 亿美元，用于购买英伟达芯片。

太平洋投资管理公司 PIMCO 是有意参与的投资机构之一。报道说，如果这一债务融资方案推进，将成为围绕 AI 建设的大规模借款交易；目前谈判仍处早期，最终也可能无法达成协议。

《金融时报》此前报道了这一融资计划。彭博社随后从知情人士处确认了筹资讨论与 PIMCO 的参与意向，SpaceX 未立即回应置评请求。
title_en: SpaceX in Early Talks for $40 Billion Financing to Purchase Nvidia Chips
content_en:
SpaceX is in preliminary discussions with banks and investment firms to raise up to $40 billion in debt financing, Bloomberg reported. The aerospace company plans to use the capital to procure Nvidia chips to bolster its artificial intelligence capabilities.

Pacific Investment Management Co. (PIMCO) is among the prominent investment firms showing interest in participating. If finalized, the transaction would rank among the largest debt-financing deals dedicated to building out AI infrastructure. However, sources cautioned that the talks are in their infancy and may not result in an agreement.

The financing plans were first reported by the *Financial Times*, with Bloomberg later confirming the discussions and PIMCO's potential involvement. SpaceX did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

title_zh: 波士顿动力任命前亚马逊 AI 负责人为 CEO，推动机器人商业化
content_zh:
波士顿动力宣布，Rohit Prasad 将出任 CEO，任命自 10 月 7 日起生效。他此前是亚马逊 Alexa 与通用人工智能业务的高级副总裁兼首席科学家。

Prasad 在亚马逊工作了 12 年，参与从早期构建 Alexa，并主导了 Amazon Nova 基础模型家族的开发。加入亚马逊前，他曾在 Raytheon BBN Technologies 从事近 14 年机器学习研究及应用工作。

波士顿动力表示，新任 CEO 将推动 AI 与机器人结合，并将智能机器规模化落地。公司目前的产品包括用于工业巡检的四足机器人 Spot、面向物流搬箱的 Stretch，以及仍处开发阶段的电动人形机器人 Atlas。Prasad 还预计加入董事会，但须完成相关批准程序。
title_en: Boston Dynamics Names Former Amazon AI Executive Rohit Prasad as CEO
content_en:
Boston Dynamics has appointed Rohit Prasad as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective October 7. Prasad previously served as Senior Vice President and Head Scientist of Amazon's Alexa and Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) division.

During his 12-year tenure at Amazon, Prasad played a pivotal role in building Alexa from its early stages and led the development of the Amazon Nova family of foundation models. Prior to Amazon, he spent nearly 14 years conducting machine learning research at Raytheon BBN Technologies.

In his new role, Prasad is tasked with accelerating the integration of AI with robotics to scale the commercialization of intelligent machines. Boston Dynamics' current portfolio includes the quadruped robot Spot for industrial inspections, the mobile robot Stretch for warehouse logistics, and the electric humanoid robot Atlas, which is currently under development. Prasad is also expected to join the company's board of directors, subject to standard approval processes.

title_zh: 💡 加菲尔德谈饰演 Sam Altman：应看清我们交出权力的对象
content_zh:
在电影《Artificial》的纽约电影节首映现场对话中，饰演 Sam Altman 的安德鲁·加菲尔德谈到，他最初观看奥特曼 2023 年在美国国会作证的视频时，觉得对方坦诚、透明：主动谈监管，也强调自己没有公司股权。这种印象随着他进一步研究而发生变化。

加菲尔德为角色花了两三个月观看和聆听相关材料。他说，拍摄期间几乎每天都有关于 AI 风险的新闻出现，参与这部电影带给他一种道德责任。他希望电影能更尖锐地呈现这些问题，照亮公众交出自主权与权力的那些人的隐蔽角落。

他此前也在《社交网络》《倒数时刻》等作品中扮演过真实人物。谈到这种创作责任，他强调保持同情心，并想象一个人看到银幕上的自己时，可能会觉得「那不是我」，甚至感到难以面对。他明确说，这只是自己的设想与投射，不能代替奥特曼本人的反应。

《Artificial》由卢卡·瓜达尼诺执导、Simon Rich 编剧，围绕奥特曼被 OpenAI 解雇又重返公司的经历展开。加菲尔德认为，电影应让观众更仔细地审视这些掌握巨大权力的人物。影片将于 12 月 25 日在美国上映。
title_en: Andrew Garfield on Playing Sam Altman: We Must Scrutinize Those We Give Power To
content_en:
During a panel at the New York Film Festival premiere of *Artificial*, actor Andrew Garfield shared his insights on portraying OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. Garfield admitted that his initial impression of Altman—formed while watching his 2023 congressional testimony—was of a candid and transparent leader who welcomed regulation and held no equity. However, this perception evolved as he delved deeper into his research.

Garfield spent nearly three months studying material for the role. He noted that with AI risks making headlines almost daily during filming, he felt a profound moral responsibility. He hopes the film will prompt audiences to more closely examine the powerful figures to whom society is surrendering its autonomy.

Directed by Luca Guadagnino and written by Simon Rich, *Artificial* chronicles Altman's dramatic firing and subsequent return to OpenAI. The film is set to hit U.S. theaters on December 25.

title_zh: 特斯拉推出万圣节模式，可用车灯和音效迎接访客
content_zh:
特斯拉官方宣布开始推送「万圣节模式」，让车辆屏幕、灯光与车外音效一起参与节日装扮。车辆在屏幕上的形象会换上幽灵服装，启用「不给糖就捣蛋」功能后，访客靠近时可触发怪诞音效与车灯闪烁。

更新还加入新的主题灯光秀、屏幕车身装扮和锁车音效，以及带惊悚效果的 Photobooth 拍照功能。车主也可以通过手机 App 远程说话，由车辆用经过处理的声音播放出来。

在同一组官方更新帖中，特斯拉将本轮软件更新标为 2026.38.3。上述节日功能已经进入推送阶段，万圣节仍在 10 月 31 日，车辆可以提前换上节日主题。
title_en: Tesla Rolls Out Spooky 'Halloween Mode' with Custom Lights and Sound Effects
content_en:
Tesla has officially begun rolling out its "Halloween Mode" as part of its latest software update (version 2026.38.3), allowing owners to dress up their vehicles with festive digital and physical effects.

When activated, the vehicle's on-screen avatar dons a ghost costume. A new "Trick or Treat" feature triggers eerie sound effects and flashing headlights when people approach the car. The update also introduces themed light shows, spooky lock sounds, and a horror-themed Photobooth feature.

Additionally, owners can use the Tesla mobile app to broadcast their voice through the vehicle's external speakers, complete with a processed, creepy voice effect. The update is currently rolling out to vehicles ahead of Halloween on October 31.

title_zh: Mistral Large 4 开放 API 预览，模型权重月底发布
content_zh:
Mistral AI 于 10 月 6 日推出 Mistral Large 4 的公开预览版，代号「le Chonk」。开发者现在可通过 Mistral Studio 使用预览 API，模型权重计划在月底开放。

这款原生多模态模型采用混合专家架构，总参数约 1 万亿，每次激活 490 亿参数，面向编程、Agent 工作流、图像理解及企业任务。官方称，模型从头在欧洲自有数据中心的 3800 张 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上训练，训练数据覆盖超过 160 种语言。

Mistral 正与网络安全机构、受信任合作伙伴及政府机构展开真实场景红队测试，测试方可访问降低内容审查限制、增强网络安全能力的版本。公司计划在开放权重时进一步公布模型架构、测评及后训练方法，并以此为基础推出面向不同专业任务的模型。
title_en: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Large 4 Preview, Model Weights Coming Later This Month
content_en:
Mistral AI has launched the public preview of its latest flagship model, Mistral Large 4 (codenamed "le Chonk"). Developers can now access the model via the Mistral Studio API, with the open-source weights scheduled for release by the end of October.

Mistral Large 4 is a native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model boasting approximately 1 trillion total parameters, with 49 billion active parameters per token. Designed for coding, agentic workflows, image understanding, and enterprise tasks, the model was trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs housed in Mistral's European data centers, supporting over 160 languages.

Currently, Mistral is conducting real-world red-teaming exercises with cybersecurity agencies, trusted partners, and government bodies. These testers have access to a specialized version of the model with relaxed content moderation and enhanced cybersecurity capabilities. Mistral plans to share more details on the model's architecture, benchmarks, and post-training methodologies when the weights are officially released.

title_zh: Hark 推出个人 AI 助手，可连接账户并代办网页任务
content_zh:
Brett Adcock 创办的 Hark Labs 上线了首款产品 Hark Pro，现已开放网页版、iOS 和 Android 应用。它可以连接用户的邮箱、日历及其他服务，记住个人偏好，并通过云端计算机执行网页任务。

Hark 的 Handoff 功能最多可同时操作 6 个浏览器窗口。用户登录网站后，助手可以继续完成任务；支持 API 的服务则可直接连接 Google、Outlook 或 MCP。Projects 用于长期保存单个项目的聊天和文件，Home 页面可生成连接个人账户数据的小应用，以及支付账单、取消订阅等操作按钮。

公司称，密码和银行卡信息保存在加密保险库中，用户可以删除自己的数据，相关信息不会出售给广告商。这些是 Hark 公布的产品与隐私承诺。

全部功能提供免费使用额度；Hark Pro² 每月 20 美元，额度为免费版的 2 倍，Hark Pro³ 每月 100 美元，提供 10 倍额度。
title_en: Hark Labs Launches Hark Pro, an AI Assistant That Automates Web Tasks
content_en:
Hark Labs, founded by Brett Adcock, has officially launched its debut product, Hark Pro. Available across web, iOS, and Android platforms, the personal AI assistant is designed to connect with users' emails, calendars, and other services to execute web-based tasks via cloud-hosted computers.

A key feature called "Handoff" allows the assistant to manage up to six browser windows simultaneously, taking over tasks once a user logs into a website. For services with API support, Hark Pro offers direct integration with Google, Outlook, and MCP. Additionally, the platform features "Projects" for organizing long-term chats and files, and a customizable "Home" dashboard that generates mini-apps for routine actions like paying bills or canceling subscriptions.

Addressing privacy concerns, Hark Labs stated that passwords and credit card details are kept in an encrypted vault. Users retain the right to delete their data, and the company guarantees that personal information will not be sold to advertisers. Hark Pro offers a free tier, with paid plans priced at $20 per month (Hark Pro²) and $100 per month (Hark Pro³) for increased usage quotas.

title_zh: 微软发布 Surface Laptop Ultra，并推出 RTX Spark 本地 AI 设备
content_zh:
微软与英伟达在旧金山活动上公布 Surface Laptop Ultra、Surface RTX Spark Dev Box，以及面向 Windows 的本地 AI 能力。

Surface Laptop Ultra 搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 芯片，微软称其目标是让写代码、复杂业务项目等 AI Agent 任务直接在电脑本地运行。

目前，Surface Laptop Ultra 已开启预订，起售价 2599 美元，10 月 16 日开始供货；Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 起售价 3999 美元。
title_en: Microsoft Unveils Surface Laptop Ultra and RTX Spark Dev Box for Local AI
content_en:
At a joint event in San Francisco, Microsoft and Nvidia announced the Surface Laptop Ultra and the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, highlighting new on-device AI capabilities for Windows.

The Surface Laptop Ultra is powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark chip. According to Microsoft, the device is engineered to run complex AI agent tasks—such as software coding and intricate business workflows—directly on local hardware rather than relying on the cloud.

Both devices are now available for pre-order. The Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2,599, with shipping scheduled to begin on October 16. The more powerful Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is priced starting at $3,999.

title_zh: 苹果：2025 年中国 App Store 生态系统促成约 4 万亿元交易
content_zh:
Apple 今天发布研报显示，2025 年中国 App Store 生态系统促成的营业额与销售额合计约 4 万亿元人民币，较 2020 年接近翻倍。

报告估算，2025 年中国开发者的 app 占中国 App Store 下载量的 93%、收入的 98%；中国开发者在全球 App Store 的下载量超过 100 亿次，来自海外用户的收入占比升至 52%。

超过 95% 的营业额和销售额无需向 Apple 支付佣金，主要来自实体商品和服务销售、数字商品与服务以及 app 内广告。

报告还提到，Apple 在 2026 年 3 月将中国区标准佣金率调整为 25%，优惠佣金率调整为 12%；2025 年 Apple 开发者关系团队与超过 2000 个开发团队、1.8 万多名中国开发者开展了交流。
title_en: Apple Report: China's App Store Ecosystem Facilitated 4 Trillion Yuan in 2025
content_en:
According to a newly released report by Apple, the App Store ecosystem in China facilitated approximately 4 trillion RMB in total billings and sales in 2025, representing a near-doubling of its market size since 2020.

The report highlights the dominant position of local creators, with apps developed by Chinese engineers accounting for 93% of downloads and 98% of revenue within China's App Store. Globally, Chinese developers have amassed over 10 billion downloads, with overseas markets now contributing 52% of their total revenue.

Notably, over 95% of the total transaction volume was exempt from Apple's commission, as these sales primarily stemmed from physical goods, services, and in-app advertising. Looking ahead, Apple plans to adjust its commission structure in China by March 2026, lowering the standard rate to 25% and the discounted rate to 12%.

title_zh: 第三家小猪佩奇主题咖啡馆将于本月在苏州开业
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，孩之宝将在 10 月于苏州开设中国第三家 Peppa Pig Play Café，将小猪佩奇的动画场景延伸到主题餐饮、互动游玩和角色见面活动中，面向学龄前儿童及其家庭。

孩之宝负责全球体验业务的高管 Matt Proulx 表示，前两家店帮助团队调整了菜单，让餐饮质量与游玩体验相匹配。家长可预约餐桌，孩子则能参与现场互动，餐食也是这一体验的重要部分。

孩之宝同时公布了巴西新项目 Transformers Mission Energon Gramado 的名称。这一与当地合作方打造的固定沉浸式设施，计划在 2026 年年底前于南里奥格兰德州开业。
title_en: Hasbro to Open China's Third Peppa Pig Play Café in Suzhou This Month
content_en:
Hasbro is set to open China's third Peppa Pig Play Café in Suzhou this October, according to a report by *Variety*. Designed for preschoolers and their families, the new venue will bring the beloved animated series to life through themed dining, interactive play areas, and character meet-and-greets.

Matt Proulx, Hasbro’s Vice President of Global Experiences, noted that insights from the first two locations helped the team refine the menu to ensure the dining quality matches the play experience. The café allows parents to reserve tables while children engage in interactive activities, making food a central part of the overall experience.

In addition, Hasbro announced a new project in Brazil named 'Transformers Mission Energon Gramado.' Developed in partnership with a local operator, this permanent immersive attraction is scheduled to open in the state of Rio Grande do Sul by the end of 2026.

title_zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰第三季度销量下降 8%，电动车销量增长 52%
content_zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰公布的第三季度数据中，核心乘用车业务销量同比下降 8% 至 40.72 万辆，主要受到中国市场需求疲软影响；同期纯电动车销量增长 52%。公司称，中国市场竞争加剧和燃油车需求下滑仍在影响整体表现。

这组数据与其在中国市场的压力同时出现：传统豪华车需求继续收缩，电动车增量尚未完全抵消燃油车业务的下滑。
title_en: Mercedes-Benz Q3 Sales Dip 8% Amid Weak China Demand, EV Sales Surge 52%
content_en:
Mercedes-Benz reported an 8% year-on-year decline in its core passenger car sales for the third quarter, delivering 407,200 vehicles. The drop was primarily driven by weakening demand in the Chinese market. In contrast, the luxury automaker's pure electric vehicle (EV) sales surged by 52% during the same period.

The company attributed the overall decline to intensifying competition in China and a broader slowdown in demand for traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles.

These figures highlight the ongoing pressure Mercedes-Benz faces in China, where shrinking demand for traditional luxury cars persists, and the growth in EV sales has not yet fully offset the slump in its conventional vehicle business.

title_zh: 派拉蒙完成收购华纳兄弟探索，新公司定名 Skydance
content_zh:
10 月 6 日，派拉蒙宣布完成对华纳兄弟探索的收购，合并后的公司定名为 Skydance。交易已取得所需监管批准，新公司以股票代码 SKYD 在纽约证券交易所交易，华纳兄弟探索股票同日停止在纳斯达克交易。

新公司旗下集合了派拉蒙、华纳兄弟两大电影制片厂，以及 HBO、CBS、CNN 和体育内容资产。《壮志凌云》《哈利·波特》《白莲花度假村》和《海绵宝宝》等 IP 归入同一集团，旗下流媒体平台订阅合计超过 2 亿。

Skydance 承诺每年至少推出 30 部院线电影，每部保留至少 45 天的院线独占窗口，并继续向独立制片公司订购内容、向第三方授权作品。公司还表示，旗下两项流媒体服务将逐步整合为一个服务。
title_en: Paramount Completes Acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, Merged Entity Named Skydance
content_en:
Paramount has officially completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, with the newly merged entity named Skydance. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the combined company has begun trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol 'SKYD,' while Warner Bros. Discovery has ceased trading on the Nasdaq.

The merger unites two legendary film studios—Paramount and Warner Bros.—alongside major media assets including HBO, CBS, CNN, and various sports networks. Iconic franchises such as *Top Gun*, *Harry Potter*, *The White Lotus*, and *SpongeBob SquarePants* now reside under one roof, bringing the company's combined streaming subscriber base to over 200 million.

Skydance has committed to releasing at least 30 theatrical films annually, maintaining a minimum 45-day exclusive theatrical window for each. The company will also continue commissioning content from independent producers and licensing titles to third parties. Additionally, Skydance announced plans to gradually consolidate its two primary streaming services into a single platform.

title_zh: 庵野秀明新作《宇宙战舰大和号 √2199》确认制作
content_zh:
Production I.G 宣布，剧场长篇动画《宇宙战舰大和号 √2199》正式进入制作。庵野秀明担任企划、制作总指挥和共同监督，出渊裕担任共同监督及设计师；动画由 Production I.G 与 khara 首次联合制作。

消息在 10 月 6 日公开，正值原版《宇宙战舰大和号》开播 52 周年。首张概念视觉图呈现战舰从荒废的地球升起的场景。作品标题保留数学符号「√」，官网标注的日文读法为「ルート 2199」。

1974 年 10 月 6 日开播的原作讲述人类驾驶宇宙战舰前往伊斯坎达尔，寻找拯救地球的方法；庵野此次的新作将以剧场长篇动画形式呈现。
title_en: Hideaki Anno to Helm New Anime Film 'Space Battleship Yamato √2199'
content_en:
Production I.G has officially announced the production of *Space Battleship Yamato √2199* (pronounced "Root 2199"), a new feature-length anime film. Acclaimed creator Hideaki Anno will lead the project as planner, executive producer, and co-director, alongside Yutaka Izubuchi, who will serve as co-director and designer.

This project marks the first-ever animation co-production between Production I.G and Studio Khara. The announcement was made on October 6, coinciding with the 52nd anniversary of the original 1974 *Space Battleship Yamato* television broadcast.

The original series followed humanity's desperate journey to the planet Iscandar to save Earth from extinction. The upcoming film's first concept visual depicts the iconic battleship rising from a desolate Earth, teasing a fresh cinematic take on the classic sci-fi franchise.

title_zh: AI 电影 Gods Don’t Give Gifts 延至 12 月上映，计划申报奥斯卡
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，AI 工作室 Fable 将电影 Gods Don’t Give Gifts 的美国上映日从 10 月 30 日调整到 12 月 4 日，并计划申报奥斯卡最佳动画长片。影片预告将于本周五进入影院，宣传海报也将铺向美国多厅影院。

影片由 YouTube 创作者 Gossip Goblin，原名 Zack London，制作，集合四个短片。故事设置在其虚构世界「人类十三个周期」中的第二个周期：人类借助技术跨越死亡和记忆等限制后，重新面对自身处境，以此讽刺社会与 AI 的关系。

Fable 准备安排学院成员和影评人提前观看，并于下月在洛杉矶投放广告，为颁奖季展开宣传。London 称，AI 让他与一个小团队把规模庞大的虚构世界搬上银幕；他也希望观众认真看待故事的前提，再跟随它走向怪诞、幽默或悲伤的后果。
title_en: AI-Generated Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Delayed to December, Eyes Oscar Run
content_en:
AI studio Fable has pushed back the U.S. release of its upcoming film *Gods Don't Give Gifts* from October 30 to December 4, according to *Variety*. The studio also plans to submit the film for consideration in the Best Animated Feature category at the upcoming Academy Awards.

Created by YouTube creator Gossip Goblin (Zack London), the film is an anthology of four short stories. Set in the second cycle of a fictional universe called "The Thirteen Cycles of Humanity," the narrative explores a world where technology allows humans to transcend death and memory limitations, serving as a satire on society's relationship with artificial intelligence.

To kick off its awards campaign, Fable will host advance screenings for Academy members and critics, alongside a promotional push in Los Angeles next month. London noted that AI tools enabled his small team to bring a massive, complex fictional world to life, hoping audiences will engage deeply with its bizarre, humorous, and poignant themes.
